format: Eight-team senior playoff field, no byes. Quarterfinal 1 is #3 Sharp Strikers vs #6 Amax Visionaries, Quarterfinal 2 is #2 EM Haulers FC vs #7 Gangat Warriors, Quarterfinal 3 is #4 Rawaha Royals vs #5 Refuel Rovers, and Quarterfinal 4 is #1 Leeward Lions vs #8 Memon Mavericks, each 35 minutes with a 5-minute halftime, played in that order starting at 8:30 AM. Semifinal 1 is the QF1/QF2 winners and Semifinal 2 is the QF3/QF4 winners, also 35 minutes with a 5-minute halftime. Finals Day runs the quarterfinals, semifinals, a Coaches & Volunteers match, Juniors games, a Dhuhr break, and the 45-minute LSL Championship Final at 2:00 PM, all on Saturday, August 8, 2026.

matches.label: Q1
matches.note: Sharp Strikers won 3-2 on penalties after a 1-1 draw.

matches.label: Q2
matches.note: Muzamil Kharooti and Haroon Ahmadi each scored twice for EM Haulers FC.

matches.label: Q3
matches.note: Abdul Ghiyas Solyman scored the only goal for Refuel Rovers.

matches.label: Q4
matches.note: Mudassir scored the only goal on a penalty kick.

matches.label: S1
matches.note: Haroon Ahmadi and Muzamil Kharooti each scored once for EM Haulers FC.

matches.label: S2
matches.note: Mudassir scored twice, and Ajmal Chakkari and Muhummud Teli each added a goal for Leeward Lions. Mosa Fazli scored for Refuel Rovers, assisted by Abdul Ghiyas Solyman.

matches.label: Finals
matches.note: Muzamil Kharooti opened the scoring for EM Haulers FC, Mudassir tied the match from the penalty spot for Leeward Lions, and Haroon Ahmadi scored during the final five minutes of extra time to give EM a 2-1 championship win.
